description: This PHP class 'Pool' manages the concurrent sending of multiple HTTP requests via a request pool, handling promises for asynchronous operations, and providing batch processing capabilities.

classes.name: Pool
classes.description: Manages concurrent HTTP requests with a pool of requests, handling promise-based asynchronous execution, and batch processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Pool with given client, requests, and configuration, setting up the request iterator and promise handling.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the promise representing the completion of all requests managed by this pool.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a batch of requests concurrently using the pool and returns an array of responses or exceptions in the order of requests.

methods.name: cmpCallback
methods.description: Helper method to set or augment callback functions for fulfilled or rejected promises within options, recording results accordingly.
